scope: Theorem 6.3 (Integral kernel removal) of the manuscript “Integral Donovan Finiteness over Witt Vectors” (preprints/Integral-Donovan-Finiteness-over-Witt-Vectors-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab8478191fa023af), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an indecomposable basic O-order R Morita equivalent to a finite-group block, and a finite subgroup F ≤ OutO(R). Consider crossed orders on R by finite groups Q with the following properties: (i) the indices [Q : Op′ (Q)] are bounded; (ii) every outer action has image in F; (iii) for each possible abstract p-group, the restrictions to subgroups of that type have finitely many based graded isomorphism classes. Then the block summands of these crossed orders have only finitely many O-linear Morita equivalence classes.
